notes.title: Hats are coming!!
notes.content:
No game is complete without hats! At least the placement is more obvious than pants, like would it cover all the legs or just the back ones? 

Alright, I'll stop yankin' your tail. These will be unlockable by playing the game and gaining experience. There will be between 5-10 hats for y'all to unlock and each providing a small adaptation.

The original idea was to keep it cosmetic, but the visibility definitely is a downside and a small effect could be a fun twist. 

Some ideas for the effects could be: like a ramping speed increase for each kill or coin collected, additional ability charge for double cooldown, reduce overall size, silencing/suppressing footsteps

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067032/0a36a6007ad4f215ef26fc76ccab51c2043bb0c0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067032/beae688de13bac261435033c9e4815e731b6afae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45067032/9579257049f5545fcc6f88958548743743358a40.png[/img]

Would love to hear what kind of hat and effect, you'd like to see!

Thanks again for all the support and feedback!
